# The names that LOOK like a path into this repository and are not one.
#
# One `<name> <reason>` per line. TestEveryNamedRepoPathExists checks this list in BOTH
# directions: a name that is missing from the tree and not listed here is a red run, and a
# listed name that nothing writes any more -- or that is IN the tree now -- is also a red
# run. So the list only ever gets shorter, and a row parks nothing.
#
# There are three honest reasons to be here, and they are the three sections below. The
# first is by far the largest, and it is the one worth reading as a list: it is every file
# a specification has PLANNED and nobody has written yet. Shrink-only means the row is
# deleted on the day the file appears, by the test, out loud.

# --- 1. A specification's plan: a file the spec says will exist, not yet written. ---

# --- 2. An invented example: a name chosen to show the SHAPE of a path. ---
